Objeto que se abre en una mision de fisu: An item you open in a Void Fissure mission; when it ends it drops one of its six Prime parts. Relics drop from ordinary missions.
Familia de reliquias: Lith, Meso, Neo, A: A relic family: Lith, Meso, Neo, Axi, Requiem and Omnia. A relic only opens in a fissure of its own era; the higher the era, the harder the mission.
Mejora de una reliquia pagada con Trazas: An upgrade to a relic paid with Void Traces: Intact, Exceptional, Flawless or Radiant. More refinement means a better chance at the rare part.
En las misiones sin fin (Supervivencia,: In endless missions (Survival, Defense...) rewards come in A, A, B, C cycles. Rotation C is the fourth reward: minute 20 or wave 20.
Lo que esta en boveda ya no sale en ning: Vaulted items no longer drop from any relic you can farm: you can only buy them, or their relic, from another player.
Mision normal en la que ademas puedes ab: A normal mission where you can also open a relic of the same era. They show a fissure icon on the star chart and change every few hours.
Fisura en una mision de Railjack (la nav: A fissure in a Railjack (ship) mission: you need a Railjack and, besides the part, they give Sevagoth holokeys.
Version dificil del mapa estelar, con en: The hard version of the star chart: much stronger enemies in exchange for better rewards. Unlocks after completing every normal node.
Cada warframe, arma o companero subido a: Each warframe, weapon or companion raised to rank 30 (40 for some) gives mastery points once. 'Not mastered' means it would still give them.
El nivel de tu cuenta (MR). Sube dominan: Your account level (MR). It rises as you master gear and unlocks weapons, mods, trading and game modes.
Version mejorada y dorada de un warframe: The upgraded, golden version of a warframe or weapon. Its parts only come from relics or from other players.
Parte de un warframe o de un arma (plano: A part of a warframe or weapon (blueprint, chassis, systems, neuroptics...). With every part you build the full item in the Foundry.
Moneda que da Baro Ki'Teer a cambio de p: Currency Baro Ki'Teer gives you for spare Prime parts. It buys the items only he sells.
El Comerciante del Vacio: aparece cada d: The Void Trader: every two weeks he visits a relay with items you cannot get any other way, for ducats and credits.
Lo comun sale mas veces y lo raro, menos: Common drops more often, rare less. In an unrefined relic: three common parts (25% each), two uncommon (11%) and one rare (2%).
Puntos que ganas con un sindicato hacien: Points earned with a syndicate by doing its missions or handing in items; spent in its shop.
Busca por el nombre del objeto, la pieza: Search by the name of the item, part, mod or relic (e.g. Rhino, Serration, Axi A7), not by questions.
Escribe el nombre de un objeto, una piez: Type the name of an item, a part, a mod or a relic.
